name: Vortex melodies
summary: Swirls in a NASA dataset (rain, ozone, carbon monoxide or nitrogen oxides: pick it in the Data menu): press Play and every swirl loops its own tune, faster spin plays faster and the dot circles once per tune. Click or press Enter on a swirl to hear it alone; Escape brings back all.
author: moran
description: Pick a dataset with the Data menu: NASA real-time precipitation (IMERG), or near-surface ozone, carbon monoxide or nitrogen oxides from NASA's GEOS-CF model. Swirls in its pattern are found by optical flow and tracked over time. Each swirl loops a short tune: faster spin plays faster, bigger swirls louder; a low hum swells where the pattern converges. Only the chosen dataset is shown and heard.
